chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad narrated from Abdullah ibn Ishaq, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Sulayman, from one who narrated to him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Fatimah (peace be upon her) said to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): 'You have married me off with a meager mahr (dower).' The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to her: 'I did not marry you off, but rather Allah married you off from the heavens, and He made your mahr one-fifth of the world, as long as the heavens and the earth exist.'
ai.seo_question: What was the dowry of Fatimah az-Zahra (peace be upon her) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Fatimah (peace be upon her) notes the modesty of her physical dowry, prompting the Prophet to reveal that her true, eternal dowry was divinely designated as one-fifth (*khums*) of the world's wealth. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that her entitlement is both a spiritual honor and a tangible economic right for the Ahl al-Bayt, enduring as long as the heavens and earth exist.
